identity.recipe: SHA256 UTF-8 JSON.stringify({type: geometry.type, coordinates: geometry.coordinates}) without rounding, reordering or repairs. Reference g1~<feature-data-relative byte offset>~<lowercase hash> under source prefix. Byte offset is an exact-read locator in the ETag/header-pinned release and distinguishes even coincident rows. Native 筆ID is retained only as safe provenance, never assumed unique.
identity.stabilityLimits: References are scoped to this fixed 2022 file revision; repacking or geometry changes may change references. A changed ETag, byte size or header fails closed. No cross-release continuity asserted.
